title: Pocketwire Advance Balances and Instant Payouts from a Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
Cross-product note of the credit risk team. When the owner of a Pocketwire Business Profile also holds a Pocketwire Advance line, the status and the outstanding balance recorded on that line decide the instant advance keep-back:

- when the owner's Pocketwire Advance line is past due or suspended, the instant advance keep-back is the whole outstanding balance of the line;
- when the line is active and owes more than zero, it is 25 percent of that outstanding balance, rounded to the nearest cent;
- in every other case — including when the owner has no such line or owes nothing on it — it is nothing.

| Pocketwire Advance line of the owner | Instant advance keep-back |
|---|---|
| past due, any outstanding balance | the whole outstanding balance |
| suspended, any outstanding balance | the whole outstanding balance |
| active, outstanding balance above zero | 25 percent of the outstanding balance, to the nearest cent |
| active, nothing owed | none |
| no line | none |

**Examples (hypothetical lines).** Active with USD 180.00 outstanding: USD 45.00. Past due with USD 180.00 outstanding: USD 180.00. Active with USD 33.40 outstanding: USD 8.35.
